verdicts.reason: Both break up the hero: the lime circle is separated from the shoe and pushed into the bottom corner, where it reads as a stray blob, and the 'Full review inside.' subhead is almost as big as the headline, so the hierarchy flattens. A scatters things more (tiny logo, the badge floating on its own, the circle cut off at the bottom right with dead space between them); B's slightly larger logo and the badge sitting on the circle hold the bottom together a little better, though the badge-on-circle overlap looks accidental and the circle is still cropped.
